description: Weather forecast for coordinates or a city name: current temperature, humidity, wind, cloud, pressure and conditions, an hourly forecast up to 48 hours, and daily highs, lows and rain up to 7 days. Data from MET Norway. Use for travel, event or logistics planning. Not for past weather or official warnings. Times in UTC. Typical response under 1 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.0099 (USDC, x402).

city.description: City name, such as Singapore (lat and lon win if both are sent).

country.description: Optional country code for the city, such as SG.

lat.description: Latitude; send with lon, instead of city.
